STEP 3. Check trunk lid latch switch connector F-16 for 
damage. 
Q: Is trunk lid latch switch connector F-16 in good 
condition?
YES : Go to Step 4.
NO : Repair or replace it. Refer to GROUP 00E, Harness 
Connector Inspection P.00E-2. The input signal from 
the trunk lid latch switch should be able to be checked 
and the functions, which are described in the 
"Technical Description (comment)," should work 
normally.
STEP 4. Check the harness wire between trunk lid latch 
switch connector F-16 and ground.
Q: Is the harness wire between trunk lid latch switch 
connector F-16 and ground in good condition?
YES : There is no action to be taken.
NO : Repair it. The input signal from the trunk lid latch 
switch should be able to be checked and the 
functions, which are described in the "Technical 
Description (comment)," should work normally.
